pairs.registryProposal: src/features/settings/sub_limits/components/__tests__/LimitsFailureSurfaces.test.tsx:57 asserts an ABSENCE after a fixed 20 ms wall sleep - on a loaded runner the buggy push can land after the window and the test stays green. No test-harness technique owns absence-after-sleep (assert-the-schedule-not-the-stopwatch covers overlap/cap/cutoff only); a rule "assert an absence after the event that would have caused it settles, never after a duration" would close it.
